summary: The tenant's logo image (404 when none).
Branding for the resolved tenant (logo, colors, default language, feature flags) so the app can theme itself before login.
Register a student (or a parent when the tenant allows it). Sends an email/OTP verification.
Email + password + device fingerprint. Returns access token, refresh token, user. Fails with DEVICE_LIMIT_REACHED when the device cap is hit.
Rotate refresh token. Reuse of a used token revokes the chain.
Verify email with the 6-digit OTP sent at registration (token links are not used).
Request an OTP (email verification, phone, login, password reset).
Always returns success, whether or not the account exists.
Reset with the 6-digit OTP from forgot-password. Revokes all refresh tokens.
DEFERRED hook. Returns 501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED in Phase 2: provider keys and token validation are not built. Not counted as implemented.
Mark biometric unlock on for this device. The biometric check itself happens on the device and unlocks the stored refresh token.
Update own profile and preferred language.
Change password; revokes other refresh tokens.
Remove one of own devices (counts toward any reset limits the tenant sets).
Search users in the tenant. Instructors see only students enrolled in courses they own (none until Phase 3 creates enrollments); other accounts answer 404.
Replace roles. SuperAdmin role is assignable only by SuperAdmin.
Reset a student's devices. Writes DeviceResetLogs and AuditLogs.

Grant the calling SuperAdmin time-boxed access inside the tenant (default 60 min, max 480). Writes a SupportAccess membership and an audit row. Needed before any tenant route can be called with X-Tenant-Id.
Revoke the caller's support access to the tenant.
Update own tenant's branding, languages, currency.
Upload logo (multipart, field 'file'). PNG, JPEG or WebP, max 2 MB, type checked from the bytes (SVG refused). Stored under the tenant's own folder; sets LogoUrl to /api/v1/tenants/current/logo.
Enable or disable a feature for the tenant.
Search and filter published courses (category, level, language, price, text).
Course detail and outline (sections, lesson titles, free previews).
Lesson content. Enforces enrollment or lesson grant, drip rules and prerequisites; returns 403 with reason otherwise.
Upload lesson video, audio or PDF (multipart, resumable chunks). Triggers AI ingest if the tenant enables it.
Authorized media stream or signed short-lived URL. Records a PlaybackSession.
Quiz pause points for the player.
Answer an embedded quiz. Returns correctness and whether playback may continue.
Enroll in a free course or one already entitled by purchase/voucher/subscription.
Heartbeat: last position, watched seconds, completion, speed. Idempotent.
Record a study session for hours and streak tracking.
Course forum and lesson Q&A threads (filter by lessonId).
Pin a thread or mark an answer as instructor-pinned.
Schedule a live class with a Zoom, Meet or Jitsi link.
Record attendance and return the join URL.
Publish announcement (also pushed via SignalR and FCM).
Register FCM token for this device.
Send message (SignalR is the live path; this is the fallback).
My XP, level, streak and badges.
Import questions from CSV or JSON.
Exams and quizzes visible to me.
Create exam with pool rules, timer, attempts, passing score, proctoring flags.
Start attempt. Freezes the question set, starts the server-side timer. Rejects past the attempt limit.
Questions for the attempt (no correct answers) and remaining time.
Report tab switch or focus loss. Stored as ProctoringEvents. May void the attempt if the exam sets a limit.
Submit. Auto-grades objective questions; essays and short answers wait for manual grading.
Result and feedback, subject to the exam's review policy.
All attempts, scores and proctoring flags.
Create with rubric, group and peer-review settings.
Submit text, link and files (new version on resubmission).
Submission detail (students see only their own or their team's).
Inline comment anchored to text range or file page.
Request a link using the student's link code.
Create a one-time code the student gives to a parent.
Attendance, grades, weekly study hours, risk alerts.
Issue a certificate manually. Automatic issuing runs on course or path completion.
Public verification: holder name, course, issue date, status. No email or phone.
Add course, lesson, bundle, plan or path.
Apply a coupon; validates expiry, limits and scope.
Create order from cart. Body picks the payment method: gateway, wallet, voucher or manual.
Gateway callback (Paymob, Fawry, Stripe). Verified by signature before any state change.
Unlock a pay-per-lesson lesson from wallet balance.
Top up with a voucher code.
Create batch. Returns a BackgroundJob id; the CSV is produced by the job.
Download the batch CSV (only available after generation, within retention).
Submit offline transfer proof with receipt image (multipart).
Approve. Completes the order or credits the wallet in one transaction. Audited.
My referral code, link, referrals and commissions.
Enable a user as affiliate with a commission percent.
Calculate payouts for a period (async job).
